lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy₂Ge₄Sn₄ (reduced formula Dy(GeSn)₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmmm (No. 15), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge and Sn each adopt tetrahedral environments with four neighbors, while Dy centers have 16 geometric neighbors. The tetrahedra share corners with one another and with Dy-centered 16-vertex polyhedra, and Ge and Sn tetrahedra share corners and edges. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
